passage: For many years, scientists believed that sleep was simply a period of rest for the body. However, recent studies suggest that sleep plays a critical role in memory, learning, and emotional health. During sleep, the brain processes information gathered throughout the day and strengthens important connections between neurons. Researchers have also discovered that lack of sleep can reduce concentration, weaken the immune system, and increase stress levels. As a result, many health experts encourage teenagers and adults to maintain consistent sleep schedules in order to improve both physical and mental performance.
